story.soThat: I can capture talking head videos or reactions
story.tasks: - Task 1: Extend recordingStore for webcam state - Task 2: Use unified get-sources IPC channel - Task 3: Add "Webcam Only" mode to RecordingModal - Task 4: Create WebcamSelector component - Task 5: Implement live webcam preview - Task 6: Add microphone selector and audio level indicator - Task 7: Implement webcam recording capture - Task 8: Add Stop Recording button - Task 9: Save recorded webcam file - Task 10: Auto-import to media library and timeline - Task 11: Handle edge cases and error scenarios - Task 12: NFR Validation - Task 13: Testing and validation

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Recording setup modal includes "Webcam Only" mode option 2. User can select from available webcam devices 3. Live webcam preview shown in setup modal 4. Audio recording from selected microphone included 5. Recording starts after countdown (3-2-1) 6. Stop button visible during recording to end capture 7. Completed recording automatically imports to media library and timeline

docs.doc: Webcam capture at 30fps with 720p resolution. Use getUserMedia with video {deviceId: selectedWebcam} and audio {deviceId: selectedMic}. MediaRecorder with WebM VP9+Opus. Audio level indicator with Web Audio API.

User selects "Webcam Only" mode → get-sources IPC extracts webcams → display dropdown of devices → live preview via getUserMedia (640x480, mirrored for UX) → microphone selection with audio level meter → countdown → MediaRecorder captures → auto-import to Track 1.

artifact.reason: Must be extended with selectedWebcam (device ID string), webcamStream state, audio level state.
Must add Webcam Only tab with webcam selector and preview components.

native.api: Audio level indicator for microphone input

story-context.constraints: - Webcam device ID stored as string (not full device object) - Unified get-sources returns webcams array - Capture resolution: 1280x720 at 30fps - Preview: 640x480, mirrored (scaleX(-1)) for natural appearance - Audio level indicator: green (good), yellow (low), red (clipping) - Auto-import to media library and Track 1 - Filename: webcam-recording-YYYY-MM-DD-HHmmss.webm - Temp directory: os.tmpdir()/chop-shop/recordings/

tests.standards: Jest for unit tests. Manual integration testing for getUserMedia, MediaRecorder, audio level indicator, auto-import flow.
tests.locations: src/renderer/src/store/__tests__/ Manual testing: webcam selection, live preview, audio levels, recording, auto-import
tests.ideas: - AC1: Manual verify "Webcam Only" tab in modal - AC2: Manual test selecting webcam from dropdown by device ID - AC3: Manual verify live mirrored preview displays - AC4: Manual test microphone selection with audio level indicator - AC5: Manual test countdown then recording starts - AC6: Manual test Stop button ends recording - AC7: Manual verify auto-import to media library and Track 1 - Unit test webcam state management - Edge case: No webcam found shows error - Edge case: Permission denied for camera/mic handled gracefully
